page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What ADA stands for
steps.why: The enzyme clears a waste product that would otherwise poison the cells of the immune system.
common_mistakes: Leaving out what the enzyme does.
steps.margin_note: Full form first, then the disease.
lines: This enzyme is very important for the immune

steps.label: The disease
steps.why: Without the enzyme both kinds of lymphocyte fail, so the child has almost no immune defence at all.
common_mistakes: Naming AIDS. SCID is inherited, AIDS is caused by a virus.
Giving the short form without the full name.
steps.margin_note: Give the full name and the abbreviation.

lines.text: It causes Severe Combined Immuno Deficiency

insider_note: Two questions, two marks: expand the abbreviation, then name the disease in full with its short form.
